plugin_bugs_observed.symptom: apply_ml.py crashed with re.PatternError: bad escape \u at position 49 when translated values contained backslash escapes (e.g. \u201e in settings_revoke_confirm_body)
plugin_bugs_observed.evidence: re.sub('...', repl_string, ...) interprets backslash sequences in the REPLACEMENT string as regex escapes; any \u/\n/\g in a translation value triggers it
plugin_bugs_observed.suggestion: translation-worker.md insert pattern (FIN-040 3.2) should warn: when using re.sub to REPLACE existing elements, pass a lambda (lambda m: repl) or escape the replacement, never the raw value as a replacement string. Pure rfind-insert (the documented happy path) avoids this, but element REPLACEMENT (stale keys) needs re.sub and hits the trap.
